source_policy: 仅六表名称、招式分组、人物等级、正邪原列为官网事实；其余阶段/威力/学习与施法成本/动作/目标/表现均为项目设计。原等级不是技能阶段；其他表的升天与英雄能力不套此政策。
adoption_rationale: 来源未载普通武功威力/阶段/费用，按学习等级给逐步增长的独立威力和学习资源门槛，六职业分别采用刀范围、剑精准、枪贯线、刺双段、弓箭及医师远程术法；既有教学不失效。普通武功无额外职业状态，差异状态按具名气功/辅助武功另行绑定，不从名称猜出控制/出血/回血。

learning.entry: own character martial library; no NPC or book required for these 234 abilities
checks: exact ability ID and own class
required route any or exact current route
learning.repeat_learning: reject before payment; duplicate request returns original committed result
learning.phase_upgrade: only phase1 exists; phase2 and above rejected without cost
learning.route_change: known ability retained; off-route ability unusable; never silently converted/refunded; explicit configuration exception follows18
learning.level_or_rank_loss: retain learned identity; insufficient qualification disables use; no refund or automatic rank repair
learning.transaction: copy/check/deduct practice and silver/add learned phase/receipt and rules version atomically; host authority; save failure retries original result, no re-charge
learning.skill_bar: explicit player binding only; existing teaching/source skills and other slots unchanged

damage_and_cost.flat_power_input: definition minimum_level, never current character level; same full flat component each declared hit before own phase coefficient
damage_and_cost.cost_frequency: once per accepted root action, never per hit/target/projectile
damage_and_cost.damage_owner: 战斗命中与减伤.v1.json; final attack interval already includes weapon; declared power passives once; no second level growth
damage_and_cost.cost_owner: 恢复与内功消耗气功.v1.json; explicit applicable reductions, then named zero-cost overrides
damage_and_cost.critical_owner: 战斗命中与减伤.v1.json and named exclusive supercritical partitions

execution.primary: explicit live hostile primary required before payment; relationship/range/LOS/safe zone checked, accepted direction locked
execution.range_passives: 射程气功采用.v1.json only explicitly eligible named sources; do not infer new range from display name
execution.per_hit: actual geometry/LOS/relationship/alive rechecked; original primary first then distance/stableID; no retarget if primary becomes invalid; extra target cap per hit
execution.projectiles: real straight collision; first hostile or solid impact; friendly ignored, never homing or through walls; no second root action for intercepted target
execution.combo_definition: assassin alone has two declared root hit ordinals, combo_skill=true; other five single-hit profiles false; targets>1 never imply combo
execution.proc_frequency: root-based anger/bleed/anti/charge restrictions owned by respective contracts; not multiplied by targets/hit ordinals
execution.zero_damage_or_miss: use23 distinct results; no cost refund
execution.paid_action: persistent receipt contains ability/phase/profile version, accepted attack interval/effective grades/cost, primary/aim/hit ordinals/random cursor; pause and offline freeze; LAN host determines results
execution.save: ordinary save waits all root/projectiles/derived events complete per05; activities save full in-flight state
execution.invalid_reference: reject configuration or command with field/ID; never use teaching profile to replace missing ordinary ability
execution.secondary_damage: spear profile explicitly5000 base, eligible灵甲爆发 replaces once per范围目标气功采用.v1.json to maximum8000; blade profile10000 remains unchanged; no primary promotion
execution.projectile_lifetime: 射程气功采用.v1.json: ceil(accepted_effective_range_mm*60/positive_speed_mm_per_second), preserve accepted speed/radius; declared base maximum_projectile_steps validates zero-bonus base only, not an extra cap on a range-enhanced action

remaining_scope: 乐师/格斗58普通攻击由乐师格斗普通武功.v1.json采用；12绝命技由绝命技与终结收益.v1.json另采用；英雄普通武功由英雄普通武功.v1.json采用；升天主动由升天武功与秘籍.v1.json采用；完整装备与世界/奖励仍待采用；234条设计不代表完整技能树或实际通关。
